verdict.rationale: Stripe's stablecoin payments docs say customers pay in stablecoins while completed payments settle in the merchant's Stripe balance in local currency, so the merchant's books never hold crypto. Community comments about USDC-to-fiat conversion friction concern Connect payouts to recipients, not merchant acceptance, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the onward bank-payout step from the fiat balance, and independent hands-on corroboration of the auto-conversion settlement.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can take crypto payments but settle in fiat — a documented option to auto-convert stablecoin receipts into a fiat balance or bank payout so my books never hold crypto

citations.quote: Let your customers pay with crypto that settles as fiat in your Stripe balance.
Customers choose their preferred stablecoin currency, crypto wallet, and payment network, while completed payments settle in your Stripe balance in your local currency.
completed payments settle in your Stripe balance in your local currency.
